column5: Defecting pays more whatever the other side does, so in a single meeting both sides defect - even though both cooperating would pay more.
When you will meet again, today's betrayal costs you tomorrow's cooperation - the shadow of the future makes cooperation rational.
Two stable outcomes exist - one side swerves, the other stays. Reputation decides who blinks; both staying is a disaster.
Hunting the stag together pays most (payoff-dominant), but grabbing the hare is safe whatever your partner does (risk-dominant).
